invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A Repository MUST only expose aggregate roots, NEVER internal child entities of another aggregate.
Query methods MUST accept a Specification object or a named finder and SHALL NOT leak SQL, ORM, or storage syntax to callers.
A single logical aggregate type MUST have exactly one Repository; duplicate repositories for the same root are FORBIDDEN.
Mutations (add, remove) MUST enlist with the active UnitOfWork and NEVER issue direct writes bypassing it.
The Repository CANNOT return stale in-memory copies when an IdentityMap is present; it MUST consult the map first.
